hook: Illegal borewell tanker points found across *Cyberabad*
hook_b: Illegal borewell tanker points found across *Cyberabad*
tldr: A TOI ground visit found groundwater being pumped and sold to private tankers near lakes, fields and homes across Cyberabad.

beats.what: Operators were drawing groundwater with high-powered motors, storing it in sumps and filling private tankers in Tellapur, Vattinagulapally, Osmannagar and near Thammidikunta lake.
beats.why: The city's water shortage is fuelling demand, and the WALTA Act 2002 bans commercial extraction in residential areas, recharge zones and over-exploited areas.
beats.care: Residents say the extraction is draining the local groundwater table; tankers were tracked to Gachibowli and HITEC City.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI tracked tankers from the sites to commercial and residential hubs in Gachibowli and HITEC City.

facts.t: Telangana's WALTA Act of *2002* bans commercial groundwater extraction in residential areas and recharge zones.
Tankers were found just *a few metres* from Thammidikunta lake on Hitex Road, inside its buffer zone.

steps.e: Pumped into private tankers on site
Tankers head to Gachibowli, HITEC City

viz.verdict: Residents say the extraction is lowering the local groundwater table.

learn.t: WALTA Act = Telangana's 2002 water, land and trees law that limits groundwater extraction
